description: Returns an MCP App card ranking restaurants with the most serious recent health-inspection violations in the chosen city (chicago, nyc, minneapolis, milwaukee, austin, denver). The server ranks a wide recent window and returns one page of that ranking. Supports limit/offset pagination.

city.description: City to query: chicago, nyc, minneapolis, milwaukee, austin, or denver.

limit.description: Maximum restaurants on this page of the ranking. Defaults to 10.

offset.description: Number of ranked restaurants to skip. Defaults to 0. pagination.next_offset in the result is the next page, or null when the ranking is finished.

name: get_city_inspections
